plugins.description: A personal agentic engineering workflow for AI coding harnesses: the Golden Rules working-style file, a planning-to-review workflow with gates, engineering guidelines, and portable agent roles. Works as a Claude Code plugin, or on any harness through the skills CLI. Layers on superpowers and EGM, installed separately. An optional jev skill adds a fast judgment layer through your own TypeSafe key, and stays off until you allow folders.
